Kagerou Bleed Build

The easy guide to breaking tons of Emperiums in the festival.

How it works (the short version)

⚔️
1. Hit super fastYour basic attack hits many, many times every second. Your shadows copy every hit.
🩸
2. Every hit cutsEach hit makes the target bleed. The bleed "saves up" damage.
💥
3. BOOM!After 5 cuts, all the saved damage explodes at once. That's 96% of your damage!
The 3 golden rules
  1. Left Hand Mastery is your best skill. Put almost every level-up into it.
  2. Only basic attacks. Banish all the throwing and ninja skills so the game never offers them.
  3. The run makes your festival build. The stronger you finish the run (level, Hel Marks), the more Emperiums you break.

Why these pieces work together

Two daggers. The dagger in your left hand gets stronger with every Left Hand Mastery level. At high levels it counts like 8 daggers!
Kathryne Keyron + Angeling cards give +1 hit per swing and +1 shadow. More shadows = more hits = more bleeding.
Glacial Heart keeps freezing the Emperium. Your Wind daggers hit frozen targets much harder.
Argiope cards + Diabolus Ring poison the target. Every poison stack makes it take more damage from everything.

Skills: where your level-ups go

Every level-up gives you picks. This is roughly how a level 400 run should end up:

SkillTarget levelWhy
Left Hand Mastery~460 (no limit!)Bigger bleed explosions, stronger left dagger, more double hits.
Ninja Aura EX~150Free STR (STR = more damage).
Mirror Image EX~140 then stopShadows copy your hits. After ~145 it gets weak, so stop.
Signum Crucis~140 then stopMakes the Emperium take way more damage.
First Aid4Heals you during the run.
Cicada Skin Shed3Dodges a hit sometimes.
Right Hand Mastery1Level 1 is enough.

Stats

✅ Put points in: AGI, DEX and LUK, about the same in each (around 80–90 each at level 400). VIT about 50–70 if you need to survive.
❌ Never: STR and INT. Ninja Aura already gives you tons of both. Banish them at the start of the run!
How do I get Signum Crucis? Banish every Kagerou attack before the job change. Then the job change starts you with Signum Crucis instead of a kunai skill.

Banish these (Holy Water)

Throw ShurikenThrow HuumaFlaming PetalsKunai ExplosionKunai SplashCross SlashFinal StrikeExploding DragonHuuma StormMeikyou ShisuiShuriken TrainingSTRINT
⚙️ Upgrade priority tip: put Left Hand Mastery above the stats, and give Mirror Image and Signum a level limit (~145). Otherwise the game spends too many picks on stats.

During the run

Pacts for the run
Blood   Agony   Grace
Grace helps you heal and survive.
Dishes for the run
Desert Scorpions   Mastela Wine   + Immortal Stew
Stew gives HP for every kill.
Go to Niflheim (dark path) and do this:
  • 📦 Open every Corrupt Chest = 1 Hel Mark = +8% damage forever in that build.
  • 👹 Win the Niflheim MVP raids: each win = a big damage boost (but you also take more damage, careful!).
  • ⏱️ Survive to 40:00: more time = more levels = more damage.
Which god altars to pray at?
🟢 ValkyrieBest one! +damage that multiplies everything. Always take it.
🟢 FreyjaGood: more critical damage.
🟡 HelA little damage, but costs 15% max HP.
🔴 Odin, Thor, Niflheim, LokiSkip them: they don't help bleeding at all, but you still get their bad side.

Before the Emperium Festival

Important: the festival uses your pacts, pet and dishes from right now, not from the run. Change them before you go!
Festival pacts
Blood   Agony   Affinity
Break Grace, take Affinity (Elements tab).
Festival dishes
Steamed Tongue   Desert Scorpions   Mastela Wine
  • ☐ Pet: Knight of Windstorm
  • ☐ Death Sentence ON in settings (+30% vs bosses, and the Emperium is a boss)
  • ☐ Save the pacts and dishes as a set called "Festival", so switching is one click next time
  • ☐ After the festival, switch back to your run set (Grace + Immortal Stew)

Made for Midgard Survivors 0.2.7. Every ×1.4 more damage = 1 more Emperium broken. The numbers come from the game's 0.2.7 files; your result depends on your account (level, Hel Marks, refines). Good luck!
